chunks: And from his will (peace be upon him) regarding what he does with his wealth,
he wrote it after his return from Siffin.

key_terms.صِفِّين: Siffin, the location of the famous battle between Imam Ali and Muawiyah

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali write regarding his wealth after returning from Siffin?
ai.summary: Recorded by Sharif al-Radi in Nahj al-Balagha, this will was drafted immediately after Imam Ali’s return from the Battle of Siffin, a period marked by political consolidation and the establishment of his caliphate. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the Imam’s role as the ultimate authority in financial jurisprudence, ensuring that his personal assets were managed in accordance with divine justice and prophetic precedent.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Amīr al-mu’minīn’s will as to how his property should be dealt with.
He wrote it on return from Ṣiffīn.
